summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 17 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added two "Advanced usage" subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Added entry linking PR 1759. Changes are additive only (846 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run because the task forbade running repo code, so all verification was by reading. Open issue: Progress.open adds the task before opening the file, so an open failure other than a missing path leaves a task behind; this follows the spec's ordering and was left for review.
